guards: .own-model-coverage.json — the tracked own-model capture columns and the scan boundary that makes every newly added nullable column answer for itself

gates.stated: A capture column with no coverage entry is a column nobody will notice stops filling.

poisonPill.why: A config whose scan boundary is not a migration timestamp: the shape that used to default to a date past every migration, so the gate scanned nothing and reported clean. A gate that reads green over zero migrations is the vacuous pass this one exists to prevent, so the pill removes the one field that decides how much it looks at.
